reference_opening.argument: This video is non-scam content because it chiefly explains Hedget’s options platform, tokenomics, auction and FTX IEO procedures while evaluating their investment risks. The creator directs viewers to an FTX referral link and describes funding bids, but also warns that the token may be overpriced, profits may not materialize, and private-sale holders could sell at listing. The presentation is best characterized as investment education and analysis with a referral promotion, rather than a deceptive solicitation.

opening.argument: Judge, the referral bonus is tied to a specific viewer action. The creator supplies an FTX registration link, tells viewers to use his referral link to make an account, and says they will receive a bonus. He then directs them toward KYC and bidding. The options explanation does not erase this reward-for-registration solicitation; it helps bring viewers to the point where they are asked to act.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense acknowledges the referral but treats it as incidental. The creator explicitly connects using his link with getting a bonus, then moves directly to an account-verification requirement. His warnings about investment risk address token-price exposure; they do not change what the registration pitch asks viewers to do.

citations.quote: use the description and use my referral link, you will get a referral bonus
after you register then you have to finish KYZ Level 2 before 24 hours of the I.O

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The bonus is described as a benefit of using a disclosed referral link, not as free cash or a guaranteed token return. The same presentation explicitly tells viewers that participation is risky. A referral incentive alongside token-sale instructions does not, by itself, establish a deceptive reward claim.

opening.argument: Judge, consider the signals together: a dated, one-hour bidding window; instructions to bid with USDT and potentially add FTT; and a discussion that puts a seven-hundred-percent profit figure in front of prospective participants. The creator also identifies a serious imbalance: private-sale buyers paid much less and face no lock-in. Calling that dangerous does not remove the pull of the outsized listing-gain comparison. This is a token-purchase pathway presented alongside a striking return figure and a deadline.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense points to warnings, but those warnings make the sales imbalance more concrete: earlier buyers can sell without a lock-in while new bidders are told how much USDT to commit. Nor does saying profits might not come negate the effect of placing a seven-hundred-percent listing-profit comparison in the same participation guide.

citations.quote: So there is no Lock In Period So that is one of the drawbacks.
in bidding you should use USDT buy with USDT first thing is you can bid from 100 to 500 USD

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The percentage describes the advantage private-sale buyers might have over later buyers; it is presented as a danger, not a promised return for viewers. The creator says that a high bid may leave no profit and emphasizes the lack of a private-sale lock-in. A scheduled sale and its funding requirements do not turn that risk analysis into a promise of gains.

opening.argument: Judge, the educational material leads into a practical acquisition route. After describing Hedget's options and token use cases, the creator tells viewers to find his referral link and register for FTX, then explains the bidding funds and additional FTT. He also says he is interested in investing despite the risk. That sequence does more than analyze a market event: it equips viewers to purchase the token through an account he asks them to open. The risk discussion sits inside that participation guide, rather than replacing it.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense calls this education with a referral promotion, but that concedes the promotional element. The video does not stop at explaining options or tokenomics: it tells viewers to create an account through the creator's link and specifies what to use for bidding. Warnings may qualify the pitch, but they do not make the participation instructions merely background information.

citations.quote: my referral link is check the description of my referrals and register in the FTX section and make you account
in bidding you should use USDT buy with USDT first thing is you can bid from 100 to 500 USD

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Participation instructions and a disclosed referral do show promotion, but they do not establish deception. The creator also calculates a high effective purchase price, questions whether profits will result, and warns that private-sale tokens have no lock-in. Those points work against an unqualified pitch for appreciation and support reading the video as analysis that includes a referral.
